msContents.summary: The text of the Itihāsasamuccaya seems to be complete, but the manuscript is badly damaged.

lg.l: kathayantaṃ hitārtthānāṃ prabhāvānat_bhutāṃs tathā |
romaśan dharmmatatvajñaṃ paryyapṛcśad yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ||

yo rakṣet_ prāṇinaṃ
rājā bhayārttaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ |
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ yat_ syāt_ tan me brūhi tatapodhana || 2 ||
ekataḥ kratavas sarvvās samastavaradakṣiṇāḥ |
ekato bhayabhītasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇaṃ |
atraivodāharantīmam itihāsaṃ purātanaṃ |
indrasyāgniś ca saṃvādaṃ śibir ośīnarasya ca |

va
rttamāne mahāyajñe jijñāsārtthaṃ śibin nṛpaṃ |
indraḥ śyenaḥ kapoto gnir bhūtvā tatrāopajagmatuḥ |

athorun nṛpateḥ prāpya kapo
taḥ śyenajāt_ bhayāt |
śaraṇārtthī mahīpālan nililye bhayavihvalaḥ |
tataḥ śanair upāgamya śyenarūpī sureśvaraḥ |
rājānaṃ sumahātmānaṃ provācedaṃ vacas tadā |
dharmmātmānan tvām ihāhur ekarājaṃ mahīkṣitāṃ |
sarvadharmmaviruddhaṃ hi kathan dharmmañ cikīrṣasi |
bhavān_ kṛtaghnan dānena satyenānṛtavādinaṃ |
kṣamayā krūrakarmmāṇam asādhuṃ sādhum asyase |

nopakāra
pare py evam upakāraparo janaḥ |
apakārapare pi tvam upakaraparo yathā |
ahite tvaṃ hitaḥ pāpe tvam apāpo hi sarvvadā |

doṣānveṣa
ṇadakṣe pi guṇānveṣaṇatat_paraḥ |
sadaiva hi vitṛptasya pīḍyamānasya me kṣudhā |
mā hiṃsīr_ rllobhato dharmman dharmmam ut_sṛja mā naśīḥ |

santrasta
rūpas trāṇārtthī svatvatto bhīto vihaṃgamaḥ |
mat_sakāśam anuprāpta prāṇagradhnurayaṃ khagaḥ |
tad evam āgatasyāsya kapotasya bhayārtthinaḥ |
katham asmadvidhāḥ kuryyuḥs tyāgaṃ sat_bhir vvigarhitaṃ |
lobhād voṣāt_ bhayād vāpi yastyajet_ śaraṇāgatam |

brahmahatyāsaman tasya pāpam āhur mma
nīṣiṇaḥ |
śāstreṣu niṣkṛtir deṛṣṭā mahāpātakinom api |
śaraṇāgatahantus tu na dṛṣṭā niṣkṛtiḥ kvacit |

yathātmanaḥ
priyāḥ prāṇās sarveṣāṃ prāṇinān tathā |
tasmān mṛtyubhayasantrastās trā prāṇino budhaiḥ |
janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhair nnityaṃ saṃsārasāgare |
jantavaḥ parikliśyante mṛtyes trasyanti te yatatā |
yannimittaṃ bhaved doṣas trāso vā krodha eva vā |

āyāso vā yato mūlam ekāṃgam a
pi tat tyajet |
mariṣyāmīti yad dukhaṃ puruṣasyaiha jāyate |
jñeyas tenānumānena paro pi parirakṣituṃ |

yathā ca te jīvitam ātma
naḥ priyan tathā pareṣām api jīvitaṃ priyaṃ |
saṃrakṣyate jīvitam ātmano yathā tathā pareṣām api sarvvajīvitaṃ |

yasmān nāham imaṃ bhītam a
rppayiṣye kapotakaṃ |
yad atra yuktam anyat te kartuṃ śyenāśu tad vada |
āhārāt_ sarvvabhūtāni saṃbhavanti nareśvara |

āhāreṇaiva
varddhante tena jīvanti jantavaḥ |
śakyante duṣkare py arthe cirarātreṇa jīvituṃ |
na tv āhāravihīnena śakyaṃ varttayituṃ cirāt |
bhakṣaād vilopitasyāsya mama prāṇa viśāṃpate |
visṛjya kāyaṃ yāsyanti panthānam apunarbbhavaṃ |
mṛte ca mayi sarvvam me putradāraṃ mariṣyati |
rakṣyamāṇāaḥ kapotatvaṃ bṛhūn_ prāṇān na rakṣa |

dharmmaṃ yo bādhate dharmmo na sa dharmmaḥ paranta
pa |
avirodhī tu dharmmo yaḥs sa dharmmas sat_bhir uccyate |
tasmād viredhe dharmmasya vicintya gurulāghavaṃ |

yato bhūyās tato rājan_ kuru dharmma
vinirṇṇayaṃ |
yato bhūyāṃs tato dharmmaḥ kaścid anyo sti khecara |
prāṇināṃ bhayabhītānām abhayaṃ yat_ pradīyyate |

varam ekasya satva
sya pradattañ jīvitaṃ bhayaṃ |
na ca viprasahasrebhyo gosahasran dine dine |
abhayaṃ sarvvabhūtebhyo yo dadāte yaṃ paraḥ |

tasya
muktasya kṣaya eva na vidyate |
hemadhenudhanādīnāṃ dātāraḥ sulabhā bhuvi |
durllabhaḥ puruṣo loke sarvvabhūtadayāparaḥ |
prāyaśaḥ puruṣo loke sarvabhūtadayāparaḥ ||

mahatām api
yajñānāṃ kālena kṣīyate phalaṃ |
bhītābhayapradānasya kṣaya eva na vidyate |
dantam iṣṭan tapas taptan tīrtthaṃ vedā śrutan tathā |

sarvvāṇy abhaya
dānasya kālan nārhanti ṣoḍaśīṃ |
catussāgaraparyyantaṃ vasundharāṃ |
abhayaṃ sarvvabhūtebhyas tayor abhado dhikaḥ |
api tyaje riyaṃrājya jīvitaṃ vā pi dustyajaṃ |

na tv imaṃ bhayasantrastasyan tyakyekṣye dīnaṃ kapo
takaṃ |
yan mamāsti śubhaṃ kincit_t tena anmani janmani |
bhavet tatra bhayārttānām ārttināśāya dehināṃ |
na hy ahaṃ kāmaye rājyan na svargan nāpunarbhavam |

prāṇi
nān dukhataptānāṃ kāmaye dukhanāśanaṃ |
yathā ca nānṛtā m etām udāhare |
satyenānena bhagavān_ prasīdatu janārddanaḥ |

āhārā
rthe samāraṃbhas tava cāyaṃ vihaṅgama |
tad yatheṣṭan tavāhāram anyad eva dadāmy ahaṃ |
sa eva vihito smākan dhātrā bhakṣaḥ kapotakaḥ |
tam evotsṛjya nāhāraiḥ kāryyam asti parair mmama |
śyonāḥ kapotān_ khādanti śrutir eṣā sanātanī |

mā rājan_ sāratām ajñātvā ka
dalīstam āruha |
tasmāt_ sarvoṣu yad dānam ekasatve ca yā dayā |
sarvasatvapradānāc ca dayaikasmin_ viśiṣyate |

sarvve vedā na
tat_ kuryyus sarve yajñāś ca khecara |
sarvvatīrtthābhiṣekaś ca yat_ kuryāt_ prāṇinān dayā |
vāṃmanaḥkarmmabhir yye tu sarvvabhūtahite ratāḥ |
dayādarśitapanthāno brahmalokaṃ vrajanti te |
gacchatas tiṣṭhato vāpi jāgrata svapato pi vā |

yan na bhūta
hitārtthāya tat_ paśor iva ceṣṭitaṃ |
prāṇināṃ badhyamānānān tu yaś śaktas samupekṣate |
sa yāvenamaṃ ghoram iti prāhur mmanīṣiṇaḥ |

rājyaṃ
śibīnāṃ sakalaṃ prayacchāmi tava dvija |
yad vā kāmayase nyac ca varjjayitvā kapotakaṃ |
yadi rān_ kapote te sudṛḍhā bhaktir īdṛśā |
tataḥ kapotatulyāni svamāṃsāni prayacśa me |
anugraham imam anye yan māṃ śyenābhiyācatese |

etat te haṃ prayacśāmi svamāṃsaṃ yā
vad icśasi |
yadyat_prin tat_ sujanaś carā vadavo na vā |
mama tu priyam evaitat_ kasmād abhihitañ cirāt |
adhruveṇa śarīreṇa pratikṣaṇavinā |
dhruvaṃ yo nārjjayed dharmma sa śocya laha ubhayat tava |
yadi prāṇyupakārāya dehe yaṃ nepayujyate |

tataḥ kim upacāro syu pratyakṣaṃ kriyate
vṛthā |
nāriktam ahaṃ yāce tava māṃsaṃ janeśvara |
tasmāt_ kapotamāyatāṃn tulayā dhṛtaṃ |
tathaivāhaṃ kariṣyāmi yan māṃ śyenābhibhāṣase |
yenaāsya rakṣaṇam me syād yad vā tad vā vihaṃgama |

evam uktvā svamāṃsāni samut_kṛ
ttāni pārtthiva |
prahṛṣṭas tulāayā māṃsaṃ kapotena kapotena samaṃ prabhuḥ |
tyaktvātmasukhabhogecśāṃ sarvvasatvahitaiṣiṇaḥ |

bhavanti para
duḥkhena sādhavo nityaduḥkhitāāḥ |
dhṛyamāṇas tu tulyā kapoto vyatricyate |
punar iścāt_ kṛtya māṃsani tataḥ prādāt_ sa pārtthivaḥ |

na vidyate yadā māṃ
saṃ kapotena samaṃ kvacit |
tataḥ prakṣīṇamāṃso sau vārūroha tulāṃ svayaṃ |
paraduḥkhātukā divyaṃ sarvvabhūtahite ratāḥ |

pekṣante
mahānmāno svaduḥkhāni mahānty api |
atha tasmin_ samārūḍhe tulām auśīnare nṛpa |
devadundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ pāapāta

tatas tya tadā
dharme matvā rāja sthitiṃ parām |
śākra svarūpam āsthāya vākyam etatad aṣābhāṣata |
indro ham asmi bhadran te kapoto havyavārddhayaḥ |

jñajñāsamānau tvā
n dṛṣṭam imaṃ yajñam upāgatau |
naitat_ pūrvo nṛpaḥ kaścān na karinti cāpare |
mahākāruṇiketnehe yat_ kṛtan duṣkṛn tvayā |
parārtthe tyajataḥ prāṇān_yā prītir abhyabhavat tava |
prāṇasaṃśayalubdheṣu na sā prāyeṣu dehināṃ |

parārtthaikāntakalyāṇī svārtthacādyanta
niṣṭhurā |
tvayy eva kevalaṃ rājan_ karaṇā taruṇāyate |
svakarmmapāśais sudṛḍhair baddhaṃ kṛtsnam idañ jagat |

tvañ jagat_duḥkhamokṣārtthaṃ baddhaḥ karuṇa
yā nṛpa |
tathā sarvvātmanā vāpi deheṣu prahitaṃ na tvayā |
yathā caivātmasantāne vāsanāpi na śoṣitā |
akṛterṣyāṃ viśiṣṭeṣu hīnān anavamanya ca |

aga
tvā tva kṛte sparddhān tvaṃ lokottamatāṃ gataḥ |
ātmaprāṇaiḥ paraprāṇānyo naraḥ parirakṣati |
saḥ yāti paramaṃ sthānan nāvartteta punaḥ punaḥ |

prā
ṇair api tvayā rājan_ rakṣitaḥ kṛpaṇo janaḥ |
svamāṃsāny api dattāni dravyeṣv anyeṣu kā kathā |

paśavo pi hi jīvanti kevalātmodaraṃ
bharāḥ |
sa punar jīvanti sāghyo yaḥ parārtthaṃ hi jīvati |
kim atra citraṃ yat_ santaḥ parānugrahatat_parāḥ |
na hi svadehaśaitāya jāyate candanadrumaḥ |
paropakārāpāraparo yaḥ puruṣaḥs sadā |
sa pan tad avāpnoti parād api hi yat_ paraṃ |

paropakāraikakadhiyaḥ svaduḥkhāpa ga
taspṛhāḥ |
jagaddhitāya jāyante sādhavas tv ādṛśā bhuvi |
yat te māṃsāni gātrebhyas samut_kṛttāni pārtthiva |
eṣā te śāśvatī kīkīrttir lloke nānucariṣyati |
divyarūpadharaś caiva pālayitvā ca medinīṃ |
sarvvalokān atikramya brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyasi |
evam uktvā tam indrāgnī jagmatudas tridaśālayaṃ |
rājā kratum iṣṭvā tu mumode devac ciraṃ |

ya idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ śibeś caritam u
ttamaṃ |
sa vidhūyeha pāpāni prayāti tridivaṃn naraḥ |
vicintya rājā svaśarīram adhruvaṃ paraṃ yaśas sarvvajanasya dussahaṃ |

śarīradānāt_ parajīva
rakṣaṇaṃ vidhāya lokatrayabhūṣaṇaṃ yayau |
